== Preview button ==

Hello. Thanks for your recent contributions to the wiki. It is always great to have new editors. In the future, could you please use the "Preview button," which is located next to the "Save page button." It allows you to see what your changes would look like before you save. It also cuts down on entries on the [[Special:RecentChanges|Recent changes page]] and reduces the workload of the servers. Please let me know if you have any questions. Thanks! ----[[User:Mainphramephreak|<span style="color:#0080FF;"> '''Willie'''</span>]] - [[User Talk:Mainphramephreak|<span style="color:#990099;">'''''HtS'''''</span>]] 00:45, December 30, 2010 (UTC)
